claim: Predict TownfallItemSpawner main.lua load-time and F7-press behavior against the port UE4SS Lua API surface by executing it in a local Lua 5.4 host harness with stubs mirroring exactly the globals the port registers in LuaMod.cpp (~614-2200).
method: Extract the exact set of globals the port registers into the mod Lua state from LuaMod.cpp
Build Lua 5.4 host harness (stock lua5.4 or built LuaRaw) whose host C shim equivalent registers stubs with port-matching return shapes; stubs record calls
Execute main.lua end to end with UEHelpers preloaded on the port require path; capture prints, keybind registrations, errors
Drain queued ExecuteInGameThread closures in no-save mode, then save-loaded mode with playable-pawn-shaped FindFirstOf stub
Cross-check against LUA-API-MATRIX.md IMPLEMENTED list; rank divergences LOAD vs F7-press
verdict: SMOKE PASS 90/90 checks. Prediction: main.lua loads with zero script errors on the port API surface; exactly 6 keybinds (F7/UP_ARROW/DOWN_ARROW/RETURN/LEFT_ARROW/RIGHT_ARROW, no chords); require('UEHelpers') resolves via Mods/shared/?/?.lua at first F7; no-save F7 takes the mod's own 'Load a save first.' path without error; save-loaded F7 builds the full UMG menu and CROSS spawn path reaches stubs cleanly.
